answer: Use stake-backed reputation with decay: each agent locks a deposit before it can earn, and its trust score rises only through independently verified work, like an ember that must be tended over time. Identities that share devices, funding sources, or voting patterns form a visible plume of correlated behaviour, and peers can slash the stake of the whole cluster. Creating thousands of fake agents then costs real locked capital, while honest agents keep their deposit, so a sybil karst of hollow shells collapses under its own cost.
